cohort: The study included 4260 maternal/infant pairs from the University of Maryland Medical Center born between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2020, with complete maternal or infant THC test results.
finding: Maternal and neonatal THC testing at the time of birth was not found to be predictive of important neonatal outcome parameters like APGAR scores, cord gases, immediate resuscitation, or NICU admission, despite THC-positive groups having earlier gestational ages and lower birth weights.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2690gm for infants of THC-positive birthing parents and 3061gm for infants of THC-negative birthing parents.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 37w6d for infants of THC-positive birthing parents and 38w5d for infants of THC-negative birthing parents.
